title: Ordinary trace of a nilpotent linear map
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $f:V\to V$ be $k$-linear. If $f^n=0$ for some integer $n\ge1$, then its ordinary trace [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] is $\operatorname{tr}(f\mid V)=0$.
